orbital_scale_gap_summary: Across 147 ground-truth Perseverance stops in the 2x2 km Western Delta Front window (43 steep stops >= 8 deg), intermediate baselines (4m MAE=1.62 deg, 16m MAE=1.12 deg) closely track rover chassis tilt, whereas the 64m coarse orbital baseline systematically underestimates steep delta scarps (steep bias=-2.31 deg, steep MAE=3.30 deg; e.g. Sol 700 measured 20.33 deg vs 64m DTM 12.65 deg).
